long_biography.plain_text:
Virtual Gaming Worlds became the platform through which Laurence Emmanuel Escalante developed casino-style social games and sweepstakes promotions for an international online audience. He studied economics and actuarial studies at Macquarie University, then spent a decade in financial planning and investment advisory. His first games business, White Knight Games, developed a Christian title but failed. Drawing on that experience, he founded Virtual Gaming Worlds in 2010 and helped devise its blend of social games, virtual currency and sweepstakes promotions.

VGW grew through Chumba Casino, Global Poker and LuckyLand Slots, with the United States as its principal market. Escalante led fundraising, product innovation and international expansion while retaining majority ownership. He later used his family office to consolidate control and invest beyond VGW. Although he resigned as chief executive and executive chairman in 2026, he remains the founder and controlling economic principal behind the gaming platform.
